## Latest articles
- [MCP servers can now provide Claude with skills and long-running tasks](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-26/01-mcp-skills-tasks.html) — Anthropic opened a beta for skills delivered through MCP and expanded support for tasks, input requests, and files.
- [OpenRouter removes three providers after prompt data investigation](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-26/02-openrouter-provider-security.html) — The platform also removed Zero Data Retention eligibility from 125 endpoints and notified potentially affected customers.
- [Light-driven nanodevices delivered medicine across the brain barrier in mice](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-26/03-brainbots-caltech.html) — BrainBots increased drug delivery about fivefold versus unactivated particles; no human trial has been reported.
- [Chrome built a synthetic web to test browser agents](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-23/01-chrome-mirror-dimension.html) — An isolated environment lets engineers test agent actions and web-borne attacks without touching real sites.
- [Yandex signs autonomous truck agreements with ITECO and Magnit](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-23/02-yandex-robotruck-partnerships.html) — The partners may acquire more than 2,000 trucks in 2028–2030, subject to testing and further decisions.
- [Yandex 360 opens preview access to external AI agents](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-23/03-yandex-360-mcp.html) — An MCP server connects agents to mail, files, and other office tools within a user's permissions.
- [Yandex robotaxis complete more than a thousand passenger rides in two Moscow districts](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-20/01-yandex-robotaxi.html) — Yandex published early trial data from Maryino and Lyublino; a test driver still sits behind the wheel.
- [Gemini gains control of apps and websites on Mac](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-20/02-gemini-mac.html) — Google began a phased US rollout of computer use, limited by language, subscription, and device requirements.
- [Two compromised Microsoft Agent Framework releases removed from PyPI](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-20/03-agent-framework-pypi.html) — Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 collected secrets on Python startup; researchers warn about cached copies and internal mirrors.
- [nginx releases fixes for five vulnerabilities in the NGINX2Root chain](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-19/01-nginx2root.html) — Researchers describe remote code execution under specific configurations; the official fixed releases are 1.30.7 and 1.31.9.
- [Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, with trading expected today](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-19/02-anthropic-ipo.html) — The company announced an offering of 980 million shares; the planned Nasdaq debut does not mean the deal has closed.
- [Google starts rolling out Gemini 4 Neon to developers and subscribers](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-19/03-gemini-neon.html) — The new model sits between fast Hydrogen and heavier Carbon; its reported benchmark results need independent scrutiny.
- [Timeweb Cloud network outage affects services across several regions](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-17/01-timeweb-cloud.html) — The provider recorded partial unavailability from 13:28 to 14:52 Moscow time and reported recovery; the number of affected sites is unknown.
- [Yandex opens a beta plugin catalogue for Alice AI](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-17/02-yandex-plugins.html) — The catalogue has more than 20 integrations, and outside developers can submit an MCP server for review.
- [Domyn adapts the Jupiter supercomputer for near-trillion-parameter model training](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-17/03-domyn-jupiter.html) — Researchers describe an experimental setup and higher throughput; training of the planned open model is still in progress.
- [Caltech robot autonomously assembles part of a structure in orbit](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-16/01-caltech-astra.html) — ASTRA added one bay to an antenna frame; the full reflector was not built, and the original announcement came on November 5.
- [Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max with a million-token context window](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-16/02-qwen4-max.html) — The flagship model is available through QwenCloud; performance and cost claims come from the company's own evaluations.
- [Apple launches a study of how people use AI for health questions](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-16/03-apple-health-ai-study.html) — A US research app studies trust and understanding, rather than offering a general medical service to all users.
- [Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-10/01-anthropic-fable-52.html) — Two versions of one model target demanding technical work, while access to Mythos requires organizational verification.
- [Why Boston Dynamics put wheels on Atlas](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-10/02-atlas-wheels.html) — Wheeled Atlas is a research testbed for motor control and transferring simulated behavior to a physical robot.
- [Yandex rovers begin deliveries in Yekaterinburg](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-10/03-yandex-ekaterinburg.html) — The robots are serving six Lavka dark stores across three districts; broader coverage and more services remain plans.
- [Yandex tests driverless container handling at an active yard](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-09/01-yandex-robotruck-container-yard.html) — The truck drove about 1.5 km through an operating yard and completed a container operation, with a remote operator and onboard observer still involved.
- [Physicl raises $10 million for targeted robot training data](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-09/02-physicl-robot-simulation.html) — Its Studio product recreates conditions in which a model fails, letting researchers train and evaluate changes in simulation.
- [Amazon brings Alexa for Shopping to text messages](https://darabelenkova1286-tech.github.io/e/2026-11-09/03-alexa-shopping-text.html) — A small invited group in the US can text the shopping agent, with broader access planned over the coming weeks.
- [Genspark presents VoicePad, a desktop voice-control device](https://shop.genspark.ai/pages/voicepad?from=note) — The five-key device pairs with a computer to launch apps and AI services and record speech. The maker says it is currently on Kickstarter; crowdfunding is not evidence of mass shipments. We spotted it in Alfa's Telegram channel.
- [Yandex delivery robots begin serving Voronezh](https://autonomy.yandex.ru/blog/rovery-poyavilis-v-voronezhe) — Yandex said on November 24 that its robots had begun deliveries from three Lavka dark stores in parts of the Kominternovsky and Sovetsky districts. Expansion to the left bank and prepared-food delivery are future plans, not current service. The blog and Telegram channel cover the same launch.
- [Yandex delivery robots now serve 13 St Petersburg districts](https://autonomy.yandex.ru/blog/bolee-300-tysyach-zakazov-za-god-i-13-rajonov-kak-nashi-rovery-osvaivayut-peterburg) — Yandex says its robots have completed more than 300,000 city orders since November 2025 and now cover delivery zones exceeding 80 sq km. The company maps sidewalks and agrees routes before entering a district. These are company-reported figures from November 20.
- [Apple and OpenEvidence launch an iPhone health AI study](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/11/apple-launches-research-study-to-explore-the-use-of-ai-for-health/) — The US study is open to up to 200,000 adults with a compatible iPhone. It examines trust in and comprehension of AI health answers; sharing HealthKit data is optional. This is a research app, not a diagnostic service or a mass-market medical assistant. Apple announced it on November 15.
- [KDDI opens Japanese preorders for the simple INFOBAR ZERO phone](https://newsroom.kddi.com/news/detail/kddi_nr-1245_4832.html) — The phone focuses on calls, SMS, music, and a 2 MP camera, without a browser or social apps. Preorders opened November 18; sales are scheduled for December 25. It is an announced device, not one already shipping.
- [Microsoft introduces its Code 2 coding-model family](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2026/11/17/ignite-2026-building-the-frontier-ecosystem/) — At Ignite, Microsoft announced Code 2 and the faster Code 2 Flash for agentic development work. Microsoft says both are available in GitHub Copilot and Foundry; performance and efficiency claims currently come from the company.
- [RIKEN reports unauthorized access to Fugaku's operational network](https://www.riken.jp/en/news_pubs/news/2026/20261116_2/index.html) — RIKEN suspended Fugaku on November 14 after finding access through a public status dashboard. Its November 17 notice says user account data and credentials may be affected, while exfiltration of research files is unproven. A November 20 follow-up says the investigation continues.
- [Magnetic microbots speed clot dissolution in a laboratory model](https://ethz.ch/en/news-and-events/eth-news/news/2026/11/dissolving-blood-clots-with-flow-generating-microbots.html) — ETH Zurich reports a sixfold speedup in a silicone vessel model with pig-blood clots; in live pigs, the reopened vessel area after 30 minutes was twice as large. The method has not been used in people, and the paper is under review. The original report dates to November 9.
- [Google opens Genie 4 in Project Genie to eligible Ultra subscribers](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-deepmind/genie-4-now-available-project-genie/) — Eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers can now use the interactive world model, edit environments with text during a session, hear adaptive audio, and share creations. Pro users have a waitlist; Google acknowledges limits in physics and long-term scene persistence.
- [Sber starts selling the portable SberBoom Track speaker](https://www.sberbank.ru/ru/sberpress/all/article?blockID=1303&lang=ru&newsID=e94d84d8-0be6-4c63-9b05-8f13933f3149&regionID=33&type=NEWS) — The GigaChat speaker costs 14,990 rubles. Sber claims up to eight hours of playback, local voice control for offline music, and Matter over Wi-Fi support. These are manufacturer specifications, not independent test results.
- [Google begins free rollout of Gemini Tasks in six countries](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/tasks-in-gemini-free-new-features/) — Gemini Tasks powered by Hydrogen is rolling out without a subscription in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India. Extra capabilities, including calls to businesses, begin in the US. This is a phased rollout, not worldwide availability.
- [Alexander Chachava leaves Yandex's board](https://ir.yandex.ru/press-releases?id=16-11-2026-01&year=2026) — Yandex announced Chachava's departure from its board and said the change does not alter operations or strategy. It also said EU sanctions against him do not extend to Yandex group companies.
- [Kaspersky details a new Retadup and CoffeeLoader infection chain](https://securelist.ru/retadup-delivers-coffeeloader/117678/) — Researchers spotted the CoffeeLoader variant in August and published their technical analysis on November 16. The chain uses a modified 7z.dll and a new Armoury packer; it is malware research, not a claim that all USB drives are infected.
- [Plural raises €1 billion for European technology investments](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/15/helsing-backer-plural-raises-1-1b-to-fund-europes-next-moonshots/) — Plural partners told TechCrunch that two-thirds will go to its third early-stage fund and one-third to follow-on investments. Target areas include energy, AI infrastructure, defence, and health.
- [Yandex and 36.6 start rover delivery for pharmacy orders in Moscow](https://t.me/autonomy_yandex/321) — Yandex Autonomy announced that orders from 36.6 pharmacies can be delivered by rover through Yandex Delivery. The company post is dated November 13; availability depends on the order address.
- [Otter adds 13 transcription languages, including Russian](https://otter.ai/blog/otter-ai-announces-its-biggest-multilingual-leap-yet-27-new-languages-and-multilingual-capabilities) — The company announced 27 additional languages, but only 13 are available now. Another 14 and automatic language switching within a meeting are planned for later; the full 31-language lineup is not live yet.
- [Meta opens access to its compact Muse Ember model](https://dev.meta.ai/resources/blog/build-with-muse-ember) — The model for frequent bounded agent tasks is available in Muse Code and the Meta Model API. It accepts text, images, audio, and video; Meta lists input pricing from $0.10 per million tokens for prompts up to 200,000 input tokens.
- [Meta adds prompt-built spaces to the Muse app](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-spaces-customize-muse-app/amp/) — Users describe a tracker, planner or project board and Muse builds a space inside the app. Meta says it is available wherever Muse is already offered.
- [Serve Robotics opens its physical AI tools to other robot builders](https://ir.serverobotics.com/news-releases/news-release-details/serve-robotics-launches-physical-ai-services-opening-technology) — Physical AI Services packages robot connectivity, data curation and data from Serve's own fleet. Serve names Bedrock Robotics among its launch customers.
- [Meta rolls out voice conversations with the Muse avatar in the US](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-muse-ai-voice-expressive-avatars/) — Muse Realtime Voice and Avatar bring live conversations to mobile, web and Mac. Support for AI glasses and the planned Charm device is still upcoming.
- [OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber for authorized security research](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber/) — The model targets vulnerability discovery and validation. Initial API and Codex access is limited to selected approved Daybreak Red users.
- [Dropbox agrees to buy Tigris Data for about $350 million](https://investors.dropbox.com/node/14451/ixbrl-viewer) — The AI-oriented object storage acquisition has not closed. Dropbox expects completion in the fourth quarter and also announced DBX Agent Cloud.
- [Aina opens preorders for a screen-equipped AI control ring](https://www.aina.com/about) — The ring combines an OLED display, microphone, speaker and physical controller. The company expects first shipments in early 2027; it is a preorder, not a mass-market release.
